description: Size keys for mating interfaces — the values of an interface's size_key (SEM-1 §2.3). Two interfaces can mate only when their resolved size keys are EQUAL, so a size key is a physical standard part or pattern, and every dimension it states cites a public standard or manufacturer source.

review.note: Key set, cross-maps, labels and definitions drafted in one pass by an agent (P3-LEX lane, 2026-10-02) against SEM-1 §4. No language facet of any entry has had a native review: every entry says `generated`, and Spanish is the bar a reviewer should read first. Facts were checked against the cited sources on the access date; no ruling has been made by a human.

definition.en: Mounting face of a NEMA 17 stepper motor: a 42.3 mm square flange with four M3 holes on a 31 mm square and a Ø22 mm centring pilot.
definition.es: Cara de montaje de un motor a pasos NEMA 17: brida cuadrada de 42.3 mm con cuatro barrenos M3 en un cuadrado de 31 mm y un piloto de centrado de Ø22 mm.
definition.fr: Face de fixation d'un moteur pas à pas NEMA 17 : bride carrée de 42,3 mm, quatre trous M3 sur un carré de 31 mm et un centrage de Ø22 mm.

definition.pt: O eixo de saída de Ø5 mm de um motor de passo NEMA 17, normalmente com um plano para parafuso de fixação; o que o furo de uma polia ou acoplamento recebe.
